::: {#exr-minibatch-epochs}

#### Ten passes over the data

Suppose one fresh [MLP](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-feedforward-network) from `make_mlp()` is trained
for 10 [epochs](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-epoch) of full-batch [gradient descent](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/optimization.html#def-gradient-descent)
with [learning rate](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-learning-rate) 0.5.
Another is trained for 10 epochs of [minibatch gradient descent](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-minibatch)
with batch size 32 and learning rate 0.1.
The minibatches of each pass come from a fresh shuffle of the training images,
rather than being drawn with replacement.
Which has the lower training loss after 10 epochs?

:::
